QuestInfo.name: [Red Leaf High] Pied Piper in the Custodial Closet
QuestInfo.1: The Pied Piper Cat ghost released some rats in the Custodial Closet. Go to there and stop the mice and the Piper from eating up all the food.
QuestInfo.2: The Pied Piper Cat ghost released some rats in the Custodial Closet. You went there and stopped the mice and the Piper from eating up all the food.

0.0: Ahhhh! Have you been to the Custodial Closet? It's overrun with MICE. How is one supposed to carry out cooking lessons if the classroom is overrun with MICE!? Can you go to the Custodial Closet and rout out the mice and the cat?

yes.0: The Pied Piper Cat should appear if you go to the Custodial Closet and start routing the mice out. You must also rout out the cat! But watch out for the ghosts there, each of their hits will damage you for 20% of your health. Ghosts can't look below so you can stay low to avoid getting hit. Don't forget that you can't use restorative items there either.
